title: Seaport首席策略师：AI资本开支热潮，历史会重演吗？
speaker: Jonathan Gaul

segments.en: Can I ask you just about semiconductor's broad list. You said the markets digested what's been happening with Johnson Huang and with NVIDIA.
segments.zh: 我能问问你关于半导体板块整体的情况吗？你说市场已经消化了黄仁勋和英伟达的动态。

segments.en: He's out the board says he's not coming back. I guess as I watched the kind of moves in its competitors, it seemed like in the aftermath of that there was some market excitement
segments.zh: 他出局了，董事会说他不会回来。我观察竞争对手的走势时，感觉在那之后市场有些兴奋，

segments.en: and maybe some of these competitors will be able to take advantage of what's happened with NVIDIA.
segments.zh: 也许其中一些竞争对手能利用英伟达发生的事情。

segments.en: How do you think about the longer-term prospects of seven industries more broadly and the wake of what happened with NVIDIA?
segments.zh: 你如何看待七大行业更广泛的长期前景，以及英伟达事件之后的余波？

segments.en: Let's step back from this and look.
segments.zh: 让我们退一步来看。

segments.en: But we've had, if you go back and I know this is going to sound good, if we go back to the railroads, you've had, this is not the first time we've had.
segments.zh: 但我们已经有过，如果你回顾，我知道这听起来不错，如果我们回到铁路时代，这不是我们第一次有

segments.en: Another industrial layer. There's a different segment down there.
segments.zh: 另一个工业层。下面有一个不同的细分领域。

segments.en: Oh my god, I'm in the shower. We really are.
segments.zh: 天啊，我在洗澡。我们真的是。

segments.en: Bring it back. But it's not like this is the first time we've had a CapEx boom.
segments.zh: 拉回来。但这并不是我们第一次经历资本开支热潮。

segments.en: I mean, at some point before all of us, we put like Kate Wires into everybody's homes across America.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，在我们所有人之前某个时候，我们就像把凯特·怀尔斯安置在美国各地的家庭中。

segments.en: Someone had a dream for that and somebody had to say, that's crazy, you're going to put a pole in front of everybody's house, you're going to wire a telephone.
segments.zh: 有人曾怀揣这样的梦想，也有人会说，这太疯狂了，你要在每家每户门前立一根杆子，还要拉电话线。

segments.en: And all of those, you know, same thing with transatlantic flight and autos and every single one of those, the technologies surpassed what we expected.
segments.zh: 所有这些，你知道，跨大西洋飞行、汽车，每一个都是如此，技术都超越了我们的预期。

segments.en: And in every one of those, you had a bunch of companies that washed out in the process as they were investing.
segments.zh: 而在每一个领域，都有一批公司在投入过程中被淘汰出局。

segments.en: Everyone, every one of those investors questioned whether the CapEx would ever pay off.
segments.zh: 每一位市场参与者都曾质疑这些资本开支是否终有回报。

segments.en: And it's for some investors it did and for some it didn't.
segments.zh: 对有些市场参与者来说回报实现了，对另一些则没有。

segments.en: This thing is going to have, if you believe in the story, it's not the promise of, hey, I think that that's, you know, well, you know, directionally understood.
segments.zh: 如果你相信这个故事，它并不是那种“嘿，我觉得方向大致明白”的承诺。

segments.en: It's what is exactly the demand in 28 and exactly how much are you, you know, willing to pay for that?
segments.zh: 关键在于28年的确切需求是多少，以及你愿意为此支付多少。

segments.en: We'll be a lot richer if we knew that. And here's the thing, we're going to think one thing on Monday and the market's going to tell us that we're wrong on Tuesday.
segments.zh: 如果我们知道这一点，会富有得多。而问题是，我们周一会有一种想法，周二市场就会告诉我们错了。

segments.en: And that's what, that's what this whole story is.
segments.zh: 这就是整个故事的核心。

segments.en: And it's not about whether, whether Jensen Wong's departure is going to change whether they're the, the bank of AI and how people perceive it.
segments.zh: 这与Jensen Wong的离开是否会改变他们作为AI之行的地位、以及人们如何看待它无关。

segments.en: That's, that's, that's, that's short-term news, but it's, it's not the story.
segments.zh: 那只是短期消息，并非核心叙事。

segments.en: But you have these huge valuations.
segments.zh: 但估值已处于高位。
